license_required.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida... constitutes a felony of the third degree

issuing_authority.value: Department of Health and Board of Medicine
issuing_authority.quote: The department shall license each applicant who the board certifies

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 21 years of age

degree_required.value: Medical degree from accredited medical school or foreign medical school meeting specified standards
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

accrediting_body.value: United States Office of Education or equivalent; World Health Organization for foreign schools
accrediting_body.quote: recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education or is a graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college within a territorial jurisdiction of the United States recognized by the accrediting agency of the governmental body of that jurisdiction

required.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year

duration.value: At least 1 year; 2 years for certain foreign medical school graduates
duration.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year... after October 1, 1992, the applicant shall have completed an approved residency or fellowship of at least 2 years in one specialty area

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.quote: Has obtained a passing score, as established by rule of the board, on the licensure examination of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)

exams.name: Federation of State Medical Boards Examination (FLEX) or National Board of Medical Examiners
exams.quote: a combination of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE), the examination of the Federation of State Medical Boards of the United States, Inc. (FLEX), or the examination of the National Board of Medical Examiners up to the year 2000

required.quote: The appropriate board shall require each person registered with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and authorized to prescribe controlled substances pursuant to 21 U.S.C. s. 822 to complete a board-approved 2-hour continuing education course on prescribing controlled substances

hours_per_period.quote: at least 40 hours of continuing education every 2 years

value: 2 hours on prevention of medical errors
2 hours on controlled substance prescribing (if prescribing controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: The boards... shall require the completion of a 2-hour course relating to prevention of medical errors... The appropriate board shall require each person registered with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and authorized to prescribe controlled substances... to complete a board-approved 2-hour continuing education course on prescribing controlled substances

available.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to any applicant who... the board certifies has: Met the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

requirements.value: Active unencumbered license in another state, 2 years active practice in past 4 years, no disciplinary action in past 5 years, passing score on national exam or equivalent
requirements.quote: Holds an active, unencumbered license issued by another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States in a profession with a similar scope of practice... Has actively practiced the profession for which the applicant is applying for at least 2 years during the 4-year period immediately preceding the date of submission of the application... Has not had disciplinary action taken against him or her in the 5 years immediately preceding the date of submission of the application

regulatory_model.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida... constitutes a felony of the third degree

credential_type.quote: the department shall license each applicant who the board certifies

is_mandatory.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida... constitutes a felony of the third degree

title_protection.quote: "Physician" means a person who is licensed to practice medicine in this state

scope_protection.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida... constitutes a felony of the third degree

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or obtaining a license by fraudulent misrepresentation or through an error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license to practice medicine by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or the authority to practice medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime relating to the practice of medicine or ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of medicine or to the ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false, deceptive, or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report a person known to be in violation of medical practice laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice medicine contrary to this chapter or to a rule of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report known to be false or intentionally failing to file required reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or receiving commissions, bonuses, kickbacks, or rebates for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or receiving any commission, bonus, kickback, or rebate, or engaging in any split-fee arrangement in any form whatsoever with a physician, organization, agency, or person, either directly or indirectly, for patients referred to providers of health care goods and services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of medicine or employing a trick or scheme in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients through fraud, intimidation, undue influence, or overreaching conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients, either personally or through an agent, through the use of fraud, intimidation, undue influence, or a form of overreaching or vexatious conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep legible medical records identifying responsible practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep legible, as defined by department rule in consultation with the board, medical records that identify the licensed physician or the physician extender and supervising physician by name and professional title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on a patient for financial gain of the licensee or third party
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on the patient or client in such a manner as to exploit the patient or client for financial gain of the licensee or of a third party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting or advertising on prescription forms without required disclaimer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promoting or advertising on any prescription form of a community pharmacy unless the form shall also state 'This prescription may be filled at any pharmacy of your choice'

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services not duly authorized by the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client, or his or her legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering drugs inappropriately or in excessive quantities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the physician's professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering medicinal drugs to oneself
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893 by the physician to himself or herself

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing medical malpractice as defined in statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing medical malpractice as defined in s. 456.50

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross medical malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross medical malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing repeated medical malpractice (three or more incidents)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing repeated medical malpractice as defined in s. 456.50

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing procedures or prescribing therapy constituting experimentation without informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on a human subject, without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to unqualified persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the licensee delegating such responsibilities knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring with another licensee to coerce or intimidate another licensee from lawfully advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with another licensee or with any other person to commit an act, or committing an act, which would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising his or her services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding in the procuring of an unlawful termination of pregnancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or aiding or abetting in the procuring of, an unlawful termination of pregnancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presigning blank prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presigning blank prescription forms

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing Schedule II amphetamines or sympathomimetic amines outside approved uses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving any drug which is a Schedule II amphetamine or a Schedule II sympathomimetic amine drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to supervise adequately the activities of physician assistants or other delegated practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to supervise adequately the activities of those physician assistants, paramedics, emergency medical technicians, advanced practice registered nurses, or anesthesiologist assistants acting under the supervision of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing growth hormones, testosterone, or HCG for muscle building or athletic enhancement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving growth hormones, testosterone or its analogs, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), or other hormones for the purpose of muscle building or to enhance athletic performance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving amygdalin (laetrile)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving amygdalin (laetrile) to any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting or concealing a material fact during licensing or disciplinary process
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting or concealing a material fact at any time during any phase of a licensing or disciplinary process or procedure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly interfering with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly interfering with an investigation or with any disciplinary proceeding

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report another licensee known to have violated disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any licensee under this chapter or under chapter 459 who the physician or physician assistant knows has violated the grounds for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found to have provided corroborating written medical expert opinion without reasonable investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found by any court in this state to have provided corroborating written medical expert opinion attached to any statutorily required notice of claim or intent or to any statutorily required response rejecting a claim, without reasonable investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board action taken against one's license in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, in writing, within 30 days if action as defined in paragraph (b) has been taken against one's license to practice medicine in another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or holding oneself out as a board-certified specialist without qualification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or holding oneself out as a board-certified specialist, if not qualified under s. 458.3312, in violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with requirements to provide patients with information about patient rights
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of ss. 381.026 and 381.0261 to provide patients with information about their patient rights and how to file a patient complaint

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the medical practice chapter or rules adopted thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony related to the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations specific to pain-management clinic operations and controlled substance prescribing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Applicable to a licensee who serves as the designated physician of a pain-management clinic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating controlled substance prescribing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with controlled substance prescribing requirements of s. 456.44

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions of firearm regulation statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of s. 790.338

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to comply with insurance requirement provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to comply with s. 627.64194 or s. 641.513 with such frequency as to indicate a general business practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing information indicating disability or supporting emotional support animal need without personal knowledge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing information, including written documentation, indicating that a person has a disability or supporting a person's need for an emotional support animal under s. 760.27 without personal knowledge of the person's disability or disability-related need for the specific emotional support animal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally implanting a patient with a human embryo without consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally implanting a patient or causing a patient to be implanted with a human embryo without the recipient's consent to the use of that human embryo, or inseminating a patient or causing a patient to be inseminated with the human reproductive material, as defined in s. 784.086, of a donor without the recipient's consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with parental consent requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the parental consent requirements of s. 1014.06

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of certain criminal offenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of; entering a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication; or committing or attempting, soliciting, or conspiring to commit an act that would constitute a violation of any of the offenses listed in s. 456.074(5)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refund patient overpayments within required timeframe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with s. 456.0625, relating to refunding overpayments to patients

definition_quote.value: The diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition

methods_authorized.quote: The diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances within the scope of professional practice and in accordance with applicable law
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the physician's professional practice

license_status_types.quote: Each board, or the department if there is no board, shall permit a licensee to choose, at the time of licensure renewal, an active, inactive, or retired status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must have credentials evaluated by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), hold active ECFMG certificate, pass ECFMG examination, and complete approved residency of at least 1-2 years depending on school certification status
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic foreign medical school registered with the World Health Organization and certified pursuant to s. 458.314 as having met the standards required to accredit medical schools in the United States or reasonably comparable standards... Has had his or her medical credentials evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, holds an active, valid certificate issued by that commission, and has passed the examination utilized by that commission

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year

pain_management_education_required.quote: The appropriate board shall require each person registered with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and authorized to prescribe controlled substances... to complete a board-approved 2-hour continuing education course on prescribing controlled substances... The course must include information on the current standards for prescribing controlled substances, particularly opiates

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: For acute pain: Schedule II opioids limited to 3-day supply, up to 7 days with documentation of medical necessity. For chronic nonmalignant pain: subject to standards of practice including treatment plans, patient agreements, and monitoring requirements
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: For the treatment of acute pain, a prescription for an opioid drug listed as a Schedule II controlled substance in s. 893.03 or 21 U.S.C. s. 812 may not exceed a 3-day supply, except that up to a 7-day supply may be prescribed if the prescriber indicates 'ACUTE PAIN EXCEPTION' on the prescription

approximate.matched_normalized: for the treatment of acute pain a prescription for an opioid drug listed as a schedule ii controlled substance in s 893 03 or 21 u s c s 812 may not exceed a 3 day supply except that up to a 7 day supply may be prescribed if

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459... who prescribes any controlled substance, listed in Schedule II, Schedule III, or Schedule IV as defined in s. 893.03, for the treatment of chronic nonmalignant pain, must: (a) Designate himself or herself as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner on his or her practitioner profile.

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: Each pain-management clinic must register with the department or hold a valid certificate of exemption

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A telehealth provider may not use telehealth to prescribe a controlled substance listed in Schedule II unless for psychiatric disorder treatment, inpatient hospital treatment, hospice care, or nursing home residents
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A telehealth provider may not use telehealth to prescribe a controlled substance listed in Schedule II of s. 893.03 unless the controlled substance is prescribed for the following: 1. The treatment of a psychiatric disorder; 2. Inpatient treatment at a hospital licensed under chapter 395; 3. The treatment of a patient receiving hospice services as defined in s. 400.601; or 4. The treatment of a resident of a nursing home facility as defined in s. 400.021.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A health care professional not licensed in this state may provide health care services to a patient located in this state using telehealth if the health care professional registers with the applicable board

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: A physician licensed to practice allopathic medicine under s. 456.4501 is deemed to also be licensed under this chapter

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Supervision means responsible supervision and control. Except in cases of emergency, supervision requires the easy availability or physical presence of the licensed physician for consultation and direction of the actions of the physician assistant

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A fully licensed physician assistant may prescribe or dispense any medication used in the supervising physician's practice unless listed on the formulary, including Schedule II controlled substances limited to 7-day supply
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A supervising physician may delegate to a fully licensed physician assistant the authority to prescribe or dispense any medication used in the supervising physician's practice unless such medication is listed on the formulary created pursuant to paragraph (f)

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician may not supervise more than 10 currently licensed physician assistants at any one time

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any practitioner of medicine licensed pursuant to the provisions of chapter 458... shall report to the Office of Insurance Regulation any claim or action for damages for personal injury alleged to have been caused by error, omission, or negligence

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The department shall be notified when any physician... Has been disciplined by a licensed hospital, health maintenance organization, prepaid health clinic, ambulatory surgical center, or nursing home or the medical staff of such a hospital... including allowing the physician to resign, for any act that constitutes a violation of this chapter

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may retain one or more consultants to operate its impaired practitioner program

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this paragraph, the department shall have, upon a finding of the State Surgeon General or the State Surgeon General's designee that probable cause exists to believe that the licensee is unable to practice medicine because of the reasons stated in this paragraph, the authority to issue an order to compel a licensee to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by the department
